about: Stretches of the six iPhone clips (IMG_5416..5422) prepared by pipeline/prep.py, each with handles around the part the edit uses. Times are source seconds.

stretches.what: the window opens on the sgraffito facade
the patterned facade, then a pan to the red houses and the square below
red houses, people crossing the square, a stone volute in the foreground (after the camera settles)
the long street from above, people walking
the counter under the window: grinder, bowl, server
through the kitchen window: red roofs and the brick church
the gooseneck pours onto the dry bed, the bed rises
the slow spiral pour, the bed bubbling
coffee from the glass server into the WARSZAWA mug
the full mug, the camera draws back to the window and the church
one take: coffee from the glass server into the WARSZAWA mug, then the camera draws back to the window and the church
the window swings open, then the camera turns right onto the long street below
the long street from above, people walking (for the timelapse): the steady wide part only, so the stabiliser does not zoom in
red houses and the castle square, people crossing (for the timelapse)
through the kitchen window: red roofs, the brick church, the sky (longer)
WARSZAWA: from the doorway along the counter, rising to the kitchen window and the brick church (whole take)
WARSZAWA: the last pours on the high bed, the spout withdraws, the camera draws back to the window and the church
WARSZAWA: the empty WARSZAWA mug, the coffee poured in, the rise to the window (whole take)
WARSZAWA: the inner sash opens, the turn right along the facade, the pilaster, the long street

WARSZAWA: the street later, then the turn away past the pilaster to the sill and the medallion (not stabilised: vid.stab zoomed it 1.45x to hide the borders of the fast turn; the turn and its motion blur stay as shot)
WARSZAWA: the outer casement, the gaze left along the sgraffito to the red houses and the Castle Square behind the volute
